author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives the composition rule for local cohomology with respect to two ideals and their sum, together with the derived-category formulation (author lemma at source lines 1653-1665, label lemma-local-cohomology-ss). The proof (source lines 1667-1688) first fixes the meaning of the composition, then gives two arguments: right adjointness of the composite and the identification of the tensor product of the two extended Cech complexes with the one attached to the combined generators (proof lines 1667-1687). Both routes are written out. H3.
